mapper.select: SELECT reminder_type,enabled='1' enabled,remind_time,repeat_week,skip_if_completed='1' skip_if_completed,reminder_text FROM user_reminder_setting WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY reminder_type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_reminder_setting(user_id,reminder_type,enabled,remind_time,repeat_week,skip_if_completed,reminder_text) VALUES(#{userId},#{request.reminderType},IF(#{request.enabled},'1','0'),#{request.remindTime},#{request.repeatWeek},IF(#{request.skipIfCompleted},'1','0'),#{request.reminderText}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled=VALUES(enabled),remind_time=VALUES(remind_time),repeat_week=VALUES(repeat_week),skip_if_completed=VALUES(skip_if_completed),reminder_text=VALUES(reminder_text)
